summary: Customer messaging and support platform with inbox, tickets, help center and the Fin AI agent.
access_note: Private apps use an access token from the Developer Hub for your own workspace; public apps use OAuth. A workspace needs a trial or paid plan.
blocker_note: Workspace is trial/paid; MCP server not available for AU-hosted workspaces.
notes: Did not find a page confirming a free developer/test workspace, so access is set to free_trial. REST breadth taken from the docs nav (contacts, tickets, help center, reporting) and the REST API reference; no review requirement for public apps was read.

evidence.quote: An Access Token is for if you're using the API to access data in your own Intercom workspace, in other words, building a private app.
OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data.
The Intercom MCP Server provides 16 tools for interacting with the Intercom API.
The Intercom MCP server is available for US and EU hosted workspaces.
